newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks dip slightly in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks dip slightly in dull trade.

text.p: Pakistan stocks dipped slightly at Monday's opening in lacklustre trading as investors stayed out on concerns about the economy, dealers said.

"Trading volume has shrunk and the index is range-bounded because there is no buying interest," dealer Hina Akhlaq said. "But the news that government plans to announce a package for the capital market is positive and could spark a rally."

The index fell 1.32 points, or 0.09 percent, to 1,541.03 in the first hour of trade. Losers led gainers 80 to 36. ICI Pakistan rose 0.65 rupees to 25.05. Hub Power fell 0.40 to 37.30. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
